title: Motion — interfaces that feel alive
text: An animation library for React, JavaScript, and Vue. Build spring animations, layout transitions, gestures, and scroll-linked motion. A useful starting point for polished, responsive interactions.
author: Example resource

title: shadcn/ui — a starting point you own
text: Accessible React components you copy into your project. Beautiful defaults with Tailwind CSS, themes, forms, dialogs, command menus, and data tables. The code lives in your repository.
author: Example resource

title: React Three Fiber
text: A React renderer for three.js. Build interactive 3D scenes, spatial interfaces, and visual experiments using declarative components and the React ecosystem.
author: Example resource

title: pgvector — similarity search in Postgres
text: Open-source vector similarity search for PostgreSQL. Store embeddings alongside the rest of your application data. Supports nearest neighbor queries and approximate indexes for semantic retrieval.
author: Example resource

title: Radix — the invisible details, handled
text: Unstyled accessible UI primitives for React. Keyboard navigation, focus management, screen reader support, dialogs, menus, popovers, and other difficult interaction patterns.
author: Example resource

title: ElevenLabs UI — components for voice
text: Open-source React components for voice and audio interfaces. Waveforms, audio players, conversational interfaces, and visual feedback for speaking and listening states.
author: Example resource

title: Core Web Vitals, explained
text: A technical guide to understanding loading performance, responsiveness, and visual stability. Explains LCP, INP, and CLS, measuring real user experience, and improving website performance.
author: Example resource

title: A structure for complex SwiftUI apps
text: The Composable Architecture is an open-source library for building Swift applications with state management, composition, dependencies, and testing. Supports SwiftUI app development.
author: Example resource

title: Inter — a typeface made for screens
text: A free and open-source variable font designed for computer screens. Tall x-height, optical sizes, tabular numbers, and a broad character set for readable product interfaces.
author: Example resource

title: Give agents the tools they need
text: The Model Context Protocol connects AI applications to tools, data sources, and workflows. Documentation for building servers that expose local resources and typed tools to AI agents.
author: Example resource

title: Excalidraw — sketch the idea first
text: An open-source virtual whiteboard with a hand-drawn feel. Draw diagrams, architecture sketches, and collaborative visual explanations. Can be embedded as a React component.
author: Example resource

title: tldraw — an infinite canvas for your app
text: An SDK for building infinite canvas experiences in React. Shapes, multiplayer collaboration, custom tools, and spatial interaction. Useful for visual editors and diagramming tools.
author: Example resource
